name: Azriel
title: Tribal leader in Manasseh
summary: Azriel is a name that appears several times in the Old Testament. The most well-known Azriel was a leader from the half-tribe of Manasseh, mentioned in 1 Chronicles. The name means 'God is my help' and is also borne by other biblical figures, including the father of Jeremiah ben Azriel during the time of Jeremiah.

keyEvents.title: Tribal leader in Manasseh
keyEvents.description: Azriel is mentioned as one of the heads of the families in the eastern half-tribe of Manasseh, a mighty warrior and well-known man.

keyEvents.title: The tribe of Manasseh taken into exile
keyEvents.description: Despite his position as tribal leader, Azriel and his people were taken into exile by the king of Assyria because they were unfaithful to the God of their fathers.

keyEvents.title: Azriel, father of Jerimoth
keyEvents.description: Another Azriel is mentioned as the father of Jerimoth, who was leader over the tribe of Naphtali during King David's reign.

keyEvents.title: Azriel, father of Seraiah
keyEvents.description: During the time of Jeremiah, an Azriel is mentioned as the father of Seraiah. King Jehoiakim sent Seraiah along with others to arrest the prophet Jeremiah and his scribe Baruch.
